problems.issue: Relying solely on a Facebook page instead of a dedicated, custom-branded website.
problems.impact: Limits professional credibility, brand ownership, advanced search engine optimization (SEO), and custom patient booking/intake workflows.

problems.issue: Low social proof and engagement metrics visible on the profile (only 346 followers).
problems.impact: May fail to build sufficient trust with prospective dental patients comparing local clinics.

problems.issue: Absence of structured schema markup for local medical businesses on a standalone domain.
problems.impact: Reduces visibility in local Google Maps and organic search results for high-intent dental keywords in Manila.

opportunities: Develop a dedicated, mobile-responsive website featuring online appointment scheduling and a service catalog (e.g., orthodontics, cleaning, surgery).
Implement local SEO strategies and Google Business Profile integration to capture high-intent 'dentist in Manila' search traffic.
Showcase patient testimonials, before-and-after case galleries, and clear pricing or insurance information to build immediate trust.
audit.summary: Manila Dental Care Center currently relies entirely on a Facebook presence, which limits its professional branding, advanced booking capabilities, and local search visibility compared to competitors with dedicated websites.

outreach.subject: Quick thought on Manila Dental Care Center's online presence
outreach.body:
Hi there,

I came across Manila Dental Care Center while looking at local practices online. Relying solely on Facebook is a great way to start, but it can make it harder for new patients to find you on Google or book appointments seamlessly when they're comparing local clinics.

Without a dedicated website, you're also missing out on local search visibility that brings in nearby patients.

We actually put together a quick live demo of what a custom, professional site could look like for your clinic. Would it be useful if I sent it over?

Best,
Rahul

---

problems.issue: Website relies entirely on Wix JavaScript-heavy rendering and heavy client-side polyfills, which may slow down initial page load (TTFB and LCP).
problems.impact: Potential drop in mobile conversions and poor SEO indexing due to heavy client-side rendering frameworks.

problems.issue: Lack of explicit local business schema markup in the provided HTML head to optimize for local dental search queries.
problems.impact: Reduced visibility in Google Local Pack results for patients searching for dental care in the area.

opportunities: Implement LocalBusiness Schema.org structured data to enhance local SEO visibility and Google Maps integration.
Optimize asset delivery and leverage Wix caching or server-side rendering improvements to enhance Core Web Vitals performance.
Add prominent call-to-action elements (e.g., 'Book Appointment' or 'Call Now') within the critical render path.
audit.summary: The Bocobo Dental Care website runs on the Wix platform, utilizing modern JavaScript polyfills and renderer configurations. While functionally operational, the site lacks visible server-side rendered SEO structured data in the head and relies heavily on client-side rendering, which can be improved for better local search ranking and faster mobile load times.

outreach.subject: Quick thought on your site's local search visibility
outreach.body:
Hi there,

I was looking over the Bocobo Dental Care site and appreciate the clean layout. 

I noticed two small technical things that might be holding you back. First, because it relies heavily on client-side rendering, it can sometimes slow down mobile load times. Second, it's missing local business schema markup in the header, which makes it harder for Google's Local Pack to pick you up for nearby patients.

We put together a quick, live demo showing how a lighter version handles these. Would it be useful if I sent it over?

Best,
Rahul
